subject.title: feat(profiles)!: require explicit config; stop auto-discovering .clawscan.yml

question: Should ClawScan reverse the existing default for project profile discovery now, before the command-backed scanner capability cited as the security rationale is introduced?
rationale: This is a deliberate public CLI compatibility change affecting established local-profile workflows; code review cannot determine whether the immediate security posture outweighs the upgrade disruption.

options.title: Preserve discovery for now
options.body: Keep the established discovery default and introduce strict explicit-config loading together with the command-backed scanner surface that requires it.

options.title: Approve a versioned breaking migration
options.body: Retain this inversion, but treat it as an intentional breaking release with tested upgrade coverage and prominent migration guidance for unattended users.

recommendation.title: Preserve discovery for now
recommendation.body: Keep the established discovery default and introduce strict explicit-config loading together with the command-backed scanner surface that requires it.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history shows direct ownership of the current profile-resolution proposal, though final public CLI direction remains a broader maintainer decision.
